atoms.what_it_does: The donor section named EffectGate records admission/idempotency/outcome bookkeeping but explicitly does not block ordinary Claude Code tool execution.
atoms.why_it_exists: Historical effect tracking and idempotency provenance.
atoms.failure_mode: Naming can be mistaken for actual pre-side-effect containment.
runtime_entrypoints: PreToolUse path as described by pinned donor/source packet
known_counterevidence: Current EntityOS design requires deterministic effect enforcement authority; donor comments state tools proceed regardless.
open_questions: Recover and bind the actual host-global blocking predecessor wache-koenig.py or preserve as unavailable provenance.

atoms.what_it_does: The completion verifier rejects effect proof only for legacy lowercase status fehler, so current non-success statuses can pass the predicate.
writes: work package completion state via reconcile path
atoms.failure_mode: DENIED/FAILED/UNCHECKED/DUPLICATE-like current states can be accepted as completion evidence.
known_counterevidence: Source comment predicts stricter Phase-2 behavior, but executable predicate remains legacy.
open_questions: Define successor-safe explicit success allowlist and adversarial regression suite.

atoms.what_it_does: A textual test:<exit_code>:<description> proof is accepted when exit_code string is 0 without runner, command, source, environment or output identity binding.
atoms.failure_mode: A forged or transplanted text claim can satisfy completion without observed execution identity.
open_questions: Bind tests to immutable execution receipt, command/source/environment/output digests.

atoms.what_it_does: Pre/Post tool effect correlation uses one mutable session-scoped active_turns.effect_id pointer while the host hook lifecycle provides a call-scoped tool_use_id.
atoms.failure_mode: Parallel or interleaved same-session calls can overwrite the shared pointer unless runtime serialization independently prevents it.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Structural race risk under parallel/batched tool calls; runtime reproduction still unperformed.
atoms.state_lifetime: session mutable pointer plus durable effect rows
known_counterevidence: Counterhypothesis: exact installed scheduler may serialize relevant hook triplets.
open_questions: Capture a real overlapping-call scheduler trace and bind tool_use_id -> effect_id -> posttool receipt.

atoms.what_it_does: PostTool verification hashes file result bytes for edits and stdout/stderr plus exit status for Bash, which is bounded execution-result evidence rather than proof of arbitrary external-world side effects.
atoms.why_it_exists: Record tool execution outcomes and bounded verification artifacts.
reads: resulting file bytes or process outputs
atoms.failure_mode: Successful tool return can be over-promoted to world-effect verification.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Requires per-invocation binding under parallel calls.
open_questions: Define effect-class-specific WORLD_EFFECT_VERIFICATION semantics and UNKNOWN outcome handling.

hypotheses: Per-invocation tool_use_id binding will eliminate the structural session-pointer correlation ambiguity without disabling parallelism.
counterhypotheses: The exact installed Claude Code scheduler may serialize every relevant PreToolUse/tool/PostToolUse triplet strongly enough that no overwrite occurs in the current donor runtime.
contradictions: EntityOS requires deterministic real-effect authority, while the donor EffectGate explicitly does not block ordinary tools.
Completion comments predict stricter Phase-2 semantics while executable status checking remains legacy.

Canonical-main architecture_archaeology feed and owner-branch frankenstein_architecture_ingest inbox are two research projections; this bridge preserves provenance and does not make either a second canonical truth authority.
